scope: One independent calibration and one independent holdout per model, 3PL/4PL, J=12. Diagnostic pilot, never full certification.

calibration.truth: Existing validation.irt_3pl4pl_root_cause.truth; theta N(0,1); independent NumPy uniforms
calibration.estimator: Production fit_python_mirt MAP, default priors, GH61, tol 1e-10, max_iter 50000. Exactly one fit/model, no retry; no setting changed after results.

holdout.truth: Same true item coefficients, independent latent traits and uniforms; original true theta retained. Not generated from estimated coefficients.
holdout.score: Existing production binary_person_abilities GH121/GH241, same ordering and complete binary data
holdout.interval: Diagnostic EAP +/- existing Z95 times conditional posterior SD. Not a production CI and not an automatically calibrated frequentist interval.

record: per-person true theta, EAP, posterior SD, interval coverage
marginal coverage, binomial MCSE, 97.5% exact CP CI per model (Bonferroni for two fixed-calibration coverage statements)
theta-band conditional coverage and quadrature stability
failure: Nonconvergence, unstable quadrature, exception or timeout is retained as FAIL; no retry or replacement. No silent subject exclusion. No scientific criterion is relaxed.

decisions.software: PASS only for complete finite output, unique IDs, valid scale, convergence, quadrature stability and 10000 preserved holdout rows; inferential disagreement remains evidence, not a software PASS claim.
decisions.coverage_diagnostic: Existing .95 +/- .02 is reported as a diagnostic screen only. No person bias/RMSE criterion was preregistered in prior certification; report those without invented acceptance limits.
decisions.certification: MEASURED / NOT CERTIFIED regardless of a favorable point estimate: one calibration cannot establish sampling coverage across calibration datasets or across the four rectangle corners. CP/MCSE condition on that calibration; no effective sample size claim of 10000 independent item calibrations.

other_blockers.parameter_SE_CI: Existing posterior-curvature, sandwich and crossprod failures remain. No unchanged campaign repeated, no data-driven SE scaling or naive penalized profile pivot. Broad covariance/CI certification requires a fresh preregistered multi-calibration campaign outside this bounded pilot.
other_blockers.SX2: Native numerical S-X2 identity is insufficient. Conditional simulation with frozen fitted items omits parameter-estimation effects; a refit bootstrap or justified null law requires separate preregistration. No p gate opens.

production: No output gates, calibration algorithms, estimator defaults, registry bytes or PR187 export/UI contracts changed by this pilot.
